newsitem.title: USA: US cash grades steady against declining outrights.
newsitem.headline: US cash grades steady against declining outrights.

text.p: U.S. cash crude grades steadied heading into Monday afternoon trade, focused on last minute business for April barrels ahead of Tuesday pipeline scheduling, cash traders said.
Outright crude prices continued weak, mainly on technical pressures and fundamental oversupply keyed by talk of unsold Brent cargoes.
Cash dealers said soft Dated Brent values forced players to look at the economics of bringing over trans-Atlantic barrels, and on the uncertainty of premium balances.
Traders said the Apr/May roll has moved out to +13 cents.
